grammarFocus: 现在完成时入门；already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分。
title: A New Chapter: Li Wei's Return to Study
instructions: 本材料为项目原创模拟教学材料，情境和数据均为模拟，非官方试题，未经真实考生难度标定。先读题，再听录音；建议第一遍抓大意，第二遍核对细节。共 10 题；单选题只选一个完整选项。填空用录音中的英文原词或数字，遵守每题词数限制。判断题 True 表示原文明示支持，False 表示原文明示矛盾，Not Given 表示缺少判断所需信息。
transcript:
Mark: Hi Li Wei! I haven't seen you for a long time. How are you?
Li Wei: Hi Mark! I'm fine, thanks. Yeah, it's been a while. I've been really busy.
Mark: Busy with what? Work?
Li Wei: No, not work. I've started a new course! I'm studying business at the community college.
Mark: Wow, that's great! When did you start?
Li Wei: I started three months ago. I've already finished the first module.
Mark: Three months already? That's fast. Have you taken any exams yet?
Li Wei: No, I haven't taken any exams yet. The first exam is next month. But I've already written two essays.
Mark: Good for you. Is the course difficult?
Li Wei: It's okay. I've learned a lot since I started. But I haven't had much free time.
Mark: I bet. Have you made any new friends there?
Li Wei: Yes, I've made a few friends. We study together sometimes. Actually, I've known one of them since the first day.
Mark: That's nice. So, how long have you been at the college?
Li Wei: For three months. I go there three evenings a week.
Mark: Three evenings? That's a lot. Did you use to watch TV in the evenings?
Li Wei: Yes, I used to watch TV a lot. But I haven't watched TV for two weeks now. I'm too busy.
Mark: I see. And have you finished your homework for this week?
Li Wei: Not yet. I still have some to do. But I've already done most of it.
Mark: Well, good luck with your studies!
Li Wei: Thanks, Mark. It's been nice talking to you.

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for 与一般过去时的区别
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时用 have/has + 过去分词，可强调过去事件的当前结果，或持续到现在的状态。already 常表示“已经”；yet 常在否定句或疑问句末表示“还”或“已经”。since 后接起点，for 后接一段时间。一般过去时把事件放在已经结束的过去时间内，如 last year 或 three months ago；它并不表示事件与现在绝对无关。已经结束的明确过去时间通常不直接搭配现在完成时。
grammar.example: I've already finished the first module.

questions.prompt: Use the present perfect: She ______ her report already.
questions.explanation: She 配 has，后接过去分词 finished。
questions.evidence: She has finished her report already.

questions.prompt: 表达“他们还没到”：They haven't arrived ______.
questions.explanation: yet 可放在否定句末表示“还没有”。
last year 是已经结束的明确过去时间，用一般过去时 went。
questions.evidence: He went to Beijing last year.
